ai_summary: Advance Agrolife Limited has announced its 24th Annual General Meeting (AGM) will be held virtually on September 18, 2026, at 3:00 P.M. IST. The company has informed shareholders, particularly those without registered email addresses, on how to access the FY 2025-26 Annual Report and AGM notice online, in compliance with SEBI listing regulations, including details for e-voting. This is a routine regulatory disclosure of meeting logistics and shareholder communication, presenting no immediate material impacts or red flags.
